name: CW Flow Trace
purpose: Define explicit causal flow records and deterministic trace reconstruction without semantic guessing.

trace.recursive_rule: A result_ref may continue to flows whose cause_ref resolves to that result identity.
trace.branching_rule: Multiple downstream flows are parallel branches unless explicit causal ordering says otherwise.
trace.cycle_rule: Revisited flow identity terminates that traversal branch.

identity.rule: Every flow participant must use a stable resolvable semantic identity.
identity.forbidden: Deriving behavior identity from display names, parent names, paths or naming convention.

compatibility.AIGMos_contract_format_1_1: flows supported when present; not required
compatibility.AIGMos_contract_format_1_2: flows required when Contract Format behavior.required contains flows

final_lock: Every modeled causal effect is reconstructible as WHO did WHAT, WHERE and WHY from resolvable structured references only.
